id="w"
name="Invented Synology watch"

items.title: Synology-SA-99:01 Photo Station
items.description:
A vulnerability allows remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script via a susceptible version of Synology Photo Station.

CVE-2099-81001 is resolved in the current release.

items.title: Synology-SA-99:03 DSM
items.description: CVE-2099-81002, CVE-2099-81003, CVE-2099-81004, CVE-2099-81006, CVE-2099-81008, CVE-2099-81009, CVE-2099-81010 and CVE-2099-81012 allow remote attackers to conduct denial-of-service attacks via a susceptible version of DiskStation Manager (DSM).
